ruleDefinitions.name: File and Directory Discovery - MacOS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of system utilities to discover files and directories

sequences.query: ((process_path = "\/usr\/bin\/file" AND process_command_line = RGX("(.){200,}")) OR (process_path = "\/bin\/ls" AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-R.*")) OR process_path = "\/usr\/bin\/find" OR process_path = "\/usr\/bin\/mdfind" OR process_path = "\/tree")
